## Form 4: a code cell with the class

```{r}
#| label: tbl-cell
#| echo: false
#| tbl-cap: "Table four, from a code cell with the class."
#| classes: wrap-right
knitr::kable(data.frame(x = c("a", "b", "c"), y = c(1.5, 2.5, 4.45)))
```
